items.zh: 第一次来要办就诊卡吗？

answers.en: Do I need a patient card for my first visit?
answers.zh: 第一次来要办就诊卡吗？

answers.en: How do I register as a new patient?
answers.note: register as a new patient 是初诊登记。

answers.en: Is there a form for first-time patients?

items.scene: 你在挂号窗口问工作人员

answers.en: I don't have my ID with me. Can I still register?
answers.note: 先说没带证件，再问还能不能挂。
answers.zh: 我没带身份证，还能挂号吗？

answers.en: I forgot my ID. Can I still see a doctor?
answers.note: 说清情况再问能不能看。
answers.zh: 我忘带身份证了，还能看吗？

answers.en: Is there another way to register?

items.scene: 你在挂号窗口问工作人员

answers.en: Can I register with my passport?
answers.note: with my passport 是拿护照。

answers.en: Do you take foreign passports?
answers.note: 问窗口收不收外国护照。

answers.en: Is my passport enough to register?
Where's the emergency room?
answers.note: emergency room 是急诊室，美式常说 ER。

answers.en: How do I get to the ER?
answers.note: ER 是急诊的缩写，最口语。

answers.en: Is the emergency entrance this way?
answers.note: 问急诊入口是不是这边。

answers.en: Is the ER open at night?
Do you have overnight emergency service?
Can I come in after hours?
answers.note: after hours 是下班后，指非门诊时间。

answers.en: Which floor is pediatrics on?
Where's the children's department?
Is pediatrics in this building?
Which window is for blood tests?
Where do I go for a blood draw?
answers.note: blood draw 是抽血，医院常用。

answers.en: Is this the line for blood work?

items.scene: 你在检验科窗口问护士

answers.en: When will the test results be ready?
How long do the results take?
Can I pick them up this afternoon?
Can you send the report to my phone?
answers.note: send to my phone 是发到手机。

answers.en: Can I get the results by text?
Is there an app for the report?
answers.note: 问有没有 App 能看。
answers.zh: 有 App 能看报告吗？

answers.en: Do I need to register again for a follow-up?
Do I need a new appointment for the follow-up?
Can I just come back with this slip?
answers.note: slip 是单子，问拿这张单子直接来行不行。
answers.zh: 拿这张单子直接来行吗？

answers.en: Can I switch doctors?
Is it possible to see a different doctor?
answers.note: 更客气，问能不能看别的医生。

answers.en: Can I change my appointment to another doctor?
answers.note: appointment 是预约，问能不能改到别的医生。
answers.zh: 能把预约改到别的医生吗？

answers.en: Can I get a longer supply of this medicine?
answers.note: a longer supply 是开更久的量。

answers.en: Can you prescribe a larger quantity?
answers.note: prescribe 是开药，quantity 是数量。

answers.en: Can I get a refill without coming back?
answers.note: refill 是续开，问能不能不复诊直接开。

answers.en: Can you write me a sick note?
I need a doctor's note for work.
answers.zh: 我需要给单位交的病假证明。

answers.en: Could I get a medical certificate?
Can you write a referral?
I need a referral to a specialist.
Can you refer me to another hospital?
answers.zh: 能把我转到别的医院吗？

answers.en: Do I have to stay here?
answers.note: 在诊室问是不是要留下住院。

answers.en: Will I be admitted?
answers.note: be admitted 是被收住院，医院常用。

answers.en: Will I need to stay overnight?
answers.note: overnight 是过夜，问是不是要住一晚。

answers.en: How much is the hospital deposit?
What's the upfront payment for admission?
Do I pay the deposit now?
Do I need to schedule the surgery?
How far out are surgeries booked?
answers.note: how far out 是要排多久。

answers.en: Can I pick a date?
Do I need to fast before surgery?
When should I stop eating?
answers.note: 问什么时候开始不能吃。
answers.zh: 什么时候开始不能吃东西？

answers.en: Can I drink water before the operation?
answers.note: operation 是手术，问能不能喝水。

answers.en: Do I need an appointment to get stitches out?
Can I just walk in for stitch removal?
answers.note: walk in 是不预约直接来。

answers.en: Where do I go to have stitches removed?
Where do I get my dressing changed?
answers.note: dressing 是敷料，change 是换药。

answers.en: Which room handles wound care?
Do I need an appointment for a dressing change?
Where do I get an IV?
answers.note: IV 是静脉输液，最常用。

answers.en: Where's the infusion room?
Do I sit here for the drip?
answers.note: drip 是点滴，问是不是坐这儿。

answers.en: How long does the IV take?
How many hours will the drip take?
answers.note: drip 是点滴，问几个小时。

answers.en: Can I go home after the IV?
Is this test painful?
Will it hurt?
Do I need to be numbed first?
answers.note: numb 是麻醉，问要不要先局麻。

items.zh: 做 B 超要憋尿吗？
items.scene: 你在超声科门口问护士

answers.en: Do I need a full bladder for the ultrasound?
answers.note: full bladder 是憋尿，医院标准说法。
answers.zh: 做 B 超要憋尿吗？

answers.en: Should I drink water before the ultrasound?
answers.zh: 做 B 超前要喝水吗？

answers.en: Can I go to the bathroom first?
Do I need to take off my clothes for the X-ray?
Should I remove my jewelry?
answers.note: jewelry 是首饰，拍片常要去掉。

answers.en: Can I keep my shirt on?
I'm pregnant. Is an X-ray safe?
answers.note: 先说明怀孕，再问能不能做；具体以医生判断为准。

answers.en: Can I have this scan while pregnant?
Should I tell the technician I'm pregnant?
answers.zh: 我要先告诉技师我怀孕了吗？

answers.en: Do you have Chinese-speaking staff?
answers.note: Chinese-speaking staff 是会说中文的员工。
answers.zh: 有会说中文的工作人员吗？

answers.en: Is there a Chinese interpreter?
Can someone help me in Chinese?
